name: DeHua TB New Decoration Material Co.,Ltd
summary: DeHua TB New Decoration Material Co.,Ltd produces and sells furniture boards in China and internationally. It operates through Decorative Materials and Customized Home Furnishings segments. The company also offers gypsum boards, engineered wood veneers, decorative paper, edge banding, hardware, and adhesives; and customized wardrobes, cabinets, flooring, wooden doors, and wall panels. It distributes its products through retail stores, home improvement companies, furniture factories, and commercial projects. DeHua TB New Decoration Material Co.,Ltd was founded in 1992 and is based in Deqing, China.
